leftEvidence.title: Adam hears of ground, toil, dust, and death

points.label: Ground and displacement
points.left: Judgments address the serpent, woman, and Adam in turn; Adam hears that the ground is cursed, names Eve, and receives clothing from the LORD God.
points.right: The LORD questions Cain about Abel, names the blood crying from the ground, and sends Cain away under a sign and stated protection.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Tree, hiding, and judgment · core · Genesis 3:14–21
points.right: Children, generations, and death · family context · Genesis 4:9–16

payload.posture: Adam receives toil from cursed ground; Cain hears blood cry from the ground and becomes a fugitive.

rightEvidence.title: Abel’s death reshapes the family’s ground and place

payload.tension: Both judgments involve ground and labor, but Cain’s scene adds Abel’s blood and departure from the LORD’s presence.
payload.title: The troubled ground in Adam’s and Cain’s judgments
